title: Implement VAD events, backpressure, and compliant errors
description:
Scope:
- Extend `UnmuteHandler` VAD/pause detection to emit canonical `input_audio_buffer.speech_started` when STT transitions to speech and `speech_stopped` when VAD detects pauses, aligned with OpenAI thresholds.
- Surface compliant `error` events when silence timeouts, buffer overflows, or backpressure thresholds are exceeded, and propagate them through `emit_loop`.
- Ensure handler resets state after interruptions and updates metrics for speech events/latency.
Testing:
- Unit tests covering VAD threshold transitions, silence timeout math, and error emission logic.
- Integration tests using simulated audio frames to trigger speech start/stop and backpressure paths, asserting emitted events and state resets.

title: Generate Jetson Thor performance validation plan
description:
Scope:
- Create load/performance test scripts (possibly extending the harness) that emulate Jetson Thor robot workloads: simultaneous audio ingest, STT processing, multimodal inputs, and actuator tool calls.
- Collect metrics (latency, GPU/CPU utilization, memory pressure) and compare against SLAs; feed results into deployment docs and health probes.
- Provide guidance on how to run tests on real Thor hardware, including prerequisites and log capture.
Testing:
- Execute the plan on staging Thor hardware (or emulated environment) to validate scripts; document known caveats.
- Automate report generation summarizing whether latency budgets were met.

title: Add integration tests for TTS module
description:
The TTS module (tts/ directory, 1,384 lines) handles text-to-speech streaming but has no dedicated integration tests.

Key components needing tests:
- text_to_speech.py: TTS streaming client
- realtime_queue.py: Queue management for TTS
- voice_cloning.py: Voice cloning workflow
- voices.py: Voice list management

Testing needed:
- TTS WebSocket connection handling
- Audio streaming with queue management
- Voice selection and validation
- Error handling for TTS failures

Create tests/test_tts_integration.py with mock TTS server.

title: Rename response.text/audio events to response.output_text/output_audio
description:
OpenAI has renamed the response streaming events:
- response.text.delta -> response.output_text.delta
- response.text.done -> response.output_text.done
- response.audio.delta -> response.output_audio.delta
- response.audio.done -> response.output_audio.done
- response.audio_transcript.delta -> response.output_audio_transcript.delta
- response.audio_transcript.done -> response.output_audio_transcript.done

Failing tests:
- test_validate_response_text_delta_against_openai
- test_validate_response_audio_delta_against_openai

Fix: Update the Literal type arguments in openai_realtime_api_events.py for these event classes.

title: Integrate conformance harness into CI
description:
Scope:
- Integrate the realtime harness (core + fuzz/latency) into CI workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions), including spinning up uvicorn with FastAPI, running harness suites, and uploading artifacts (event traces, JSON latency reports) for debugging.
- Provide developer scripts (`scripts/run_realtime_harness.sh`) to reproduce CI runs locally.
- Ensure CI failures block merges and emit concise summaries.
Testing:
- Dry-run CI locally via `act` or similar if available; otherwise ensure workflow syntax validated.
- Document how to interpret harness artifacts and rerun targeted suites.

title: Add 'usage' field to ConversationItemInputAudioTranscriptionCompleted
description:
OpenAI's transcription completed event now requires a 'usage' field with token usage information.

Failing test:
- test_validate_transcription_completed_against_openai

Fix: Add usage field to ConversationItemInputAudioTranscriptionCompleted in openai_realtime_api_events.py:
usage: UsageStats | None = None

The UsageStats model already exists with total_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens fields.

title: Review and document subprotocol requirement for WebSocket connections
description:
The current implementation requires 'realtime' subprotocol in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header, but the official OpenAI Python client may not strictly require this.

Current behavior (websocket_auth.py):
- Validates Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: realtime header
- Returns error if missing

Questions to investigate:
1. Does OpenAI's server still require the subprotocol?
2. Can we make it optional for broader client compatibility?
3. Should we update documentation to clarify requirements?

Test against OpenAI's actual Realtime API endpoint to verify current requirements.

title: Add OutputAudioBufferClear client event
description:
The official OpenAI Realtime API includes output_audio_buffer.clear as a client event to clear the server's audio output buffer. This event is missing from our implementation.

Skipped test:
- test_output_audio_buffer_clear_not_implemented

Fix: Add OutputAudioBufferClear event class in openai_realtime_api_events.py and add it to ClientEvent union.

title: Add multimodal image & metadata ingestion
description:
Scope:
- Implement handlers for `input_image_buffer.append` (or similar) events in `main_websocket.receive_loop`, decoding base64 image payloads, validating mimetypes, and storing references in a per-session media store.
- Support metadata modality items (sensor readings, structured context) with deterministic ordering and conversation-state hooks.
- Update `UnmuteHandler`/LLM context builder to inject stored images/metadata when building prompts and to persist them for reconnects.
- Ensure storage quotas and cleanup semantics match Jetson constraints.
Testing:
- Unit tests for image decoding/validation and metadata storage.
- Integration tests simulating multimodal flow: append image → `response.create` referencing it → verify context builder receives references and recorder persists them.

title: Implement realtime session reconciliation & event routing
description:
Scope:
- Expand `receive_loop`/`emit_loop` and `UnmuteHandler` to support the full OpenAI Realtime client event set: `response.create`, `response.cancel`, `response.output_item.*`, `conversation.item.create/update/delete`, `input_audio_buffer.commit/reset`, etc.
- Maintain per-session state machine tracking outstanding responses, conversation items, and buffer pointers; ensure acknowledgement events (`*.updated`, `response.completed/failed/cancelled`) fire in order.
- Ensure recorder/replay files serialize deterministic state snapshots for reconnects.
- Document state transitions and invariants.
Testing:
- Add async tests using FastAPI TestClient or a harness stub to simulate event sequences (create/cancel/update, reconnect) and assert emitted events/state.
- Add unit tests for state reconciliation helpers verifying idempotence and conflict detection.

title: Add unit tests for quest_manager.py
description:
quest_manager.py (178 lines) implements a RAII-like pattern for async resource management but has no dedicated test file.

The module provides:
- Lifecycle hooks for async resources
- Task coordination and cleanup
- Error handling for async context managers

Testing needed:
- Quest lifecycle (start, complete, cancel)
- Resource cleanup on exceptions
- Concurrent quest handling
- Edge cases for async context managers

Create tests/test_quest_manager.py with comprehensive coverage.

title: Add type hints to main_websocket.py async handlers
description:
main_websocket.py has 17 untyped functions, primarily async handlers and middleware.

Missing type hints in:
- receive_loop() and emit_loop() functions
- Middleware dispatch functions
- Helper functions

Adding proper type hints will:
- Improve IDE support for async patterns
- Enable better static analysis
- Document expected parameter/return types for WebSocket handlers

title: Add type hints to LLM module files
description:
Several LLM module files have incomplete type hint coverage:

- llm_utils.py: 183 lines, 10 type hints (partial)
- chatbot.py: 121 lines, 10 type hints (partial)
- quiz_show_questions.py: 165 lines, 2 type hints (minimal)
- system_prompt.py: 409 lines, 8 docstrings but limited hints

Adding comprehensive type hints will:
- Improve IDE support for LLM integration code
- Enable better static analysis
- Document expected types for prompt templates and chat state

title: Extract service handlers from main_websocket.py
description:
main_websocket.py has high complexity (793 lines):
- 118 conditional branches
- 42 deeply nested lines  
- 17 untyped functions
- Mixes concerns: auth, session management, event dispatch, health checks

Recommended refactoring:
1. Extract WebSocketSessionManager class for session lifecycle
2. Extract EventDispatcher class for message routing in receive_loop
3. Move health check logic to dedicated HealthService
4. Keep main_websocket.py as thin FastAPI route definitions

This separation enables better unit testing and clearer responsibility boundaries.

title: Add type hints to unmute_handler.py untyped functions
description:
unmute_handler.py has 19 untyped functions despite being the largest and most critical file.

Missing type hints affect:
- IDE autocompletion and error detection
- Static analysis with pyright/mypy
- Code documentation and API clarity

Files to update:
- unmute_handler.py: 19 untyped functions (43 existing type hints)

This should be done before or alongside the refactoring task (unmute-k15).

title: Add README documentation for test harness
description:
The realtime test harness (tests/realtime_harness/, 2,758 lines) is sophisticated infrastructure but may need better documentation.

Components:
- runner.py: Test execution engine (701 lines)
- fuzz_generators.py: Fuzzing strategies (351 lines)
- validators.py: Event validation (356 lines)
- benchmarks.py: Performance testing (408 lines)

Documentation needed:
- How to run the conformance harness
- How to add new test fixtures
- How to interpret benchmark results
- Architecture overview of the test infrastructure

Review tests/realtime_harness/README.md and enhance if needed.

title: Refactor realtime websocket handshake & capability negotiation
description:
Scope:
- In `unmute/main_websocket.py`, ensure `websocket_route` enforces `realtime` subprotocol, validates Authorization/OpenAI-Beta headers, and negotiates capability extensions (e.g., `unmute.extensions` list) from an initial `session.update` payload.
- Persist negotiated config on `UnmuteHandler` (voice, instructions, allowed extensions) and reject unsupported extensions with spec-compliant `error` events before closing.
- Wire additional auth/config validation helpers in `unmute/service_discovery.py` or a new module, covering rate limits and Jetson-specific configs.
- Update `scripts/example_websocket_client.py` to reflect required headers/subprotocols.
Testing:
- Add FastAPI TestClient websocket tests verifying handshake success/failure cases, extension negotiation, and auth errors.
- Include negative tests for missing subprotocol, unsupported extension, and malformed config payloads.

title: Profile realtime pipeline & mitigate bottlenecks
description:
Scope:
- Instrument audio ingestion, STT flush pipeline, LLM streaming, actuator routing, and websocket loops with tracing spans/metrics (e.g., `asyncio.TaskGroup` instrumentation, Prometheus histograms) to identify latency hotspots.
- Profile under representative loads (including harness traces) to detect GIL contention or queue bottlenecks; implement mitigations (task groups, bounded queues, `asyncio.StreamReader` optimizations, executor offloading).
- Capture before/after metrics and document improvements.
Testing:
- Use synthetic load tests to confirm latency reductions and absence of regressions.
- Ensure tracing hooks do not degrade throughput; add unit tests where feasible for new instrumentation utilities.

title: Route realtime tool calls to actuators with interrupts
description:
Scope:
- Extend `UnmuteHandler` (or dedicated tool routing module) to subscribe to `response.tool_call.delta/done` events, map tool IDs to actuator microservice clients, and handle async invocation with retries/timeouts.
- Emit `response.tool_call.output` events streaming actuator stdout/stderr + final success/failure payloads.
- Implement interrupt semantics: allow `response.cancel`, VAD interruptions, or session teardown to cancel in-flight tool calls, ensuring actuator services receive cancellation signals and state is cleaned up.
- Log/tool telemetry for actuator RTTs.
Testing:
- Integration tests with mocked actuator clients verifying success/failure paths, streaming outputs, and cancellation behavior.
- Concurrency tests covering multiple parallel tool calls and race conditions with response cancellation.

title: Upgrade minimal OpenAI compatibility version
description: Bump the minimal version of openai, we are validating against to 2.0.0 instead of 1.70.0

title: Reduce import coupling in unmute_handler.py
description:
unmute_handler.py has 28 imports (7 stdlib, 4 3rd-party, 17 local), indicating high coupling.

Current local imports:
- streamhandler, audio/buffer, session_state
- STT, TTS, llm modules
- metrics, tracing, exceptions
- Various utilities

Recommendations:
1. Use dependency injection for services (STT, TTS, LLM)
2. Create interfaces/protocols for external services
3. Move some functionality to the services being imported
4. Consider a service locator pattern

This should be addressed alongside the unmute_handler refactoring (unmute-k15).

title: Document Jetson Thor realtime deployment
description:
Scope:
- Produce a deployment guide (`docs/jetson_thor_realtime.md`) covering recommended process layout, GPU/CPU pinning, CUDA versions, container topology, and how to co-locate websocket router, telemetry, STT/TTS services on Jetson Thor.
- Incorporate findings from profiling/health probes, including resource budgeting, logging, and failover procedures.
- Provide scripts or systemd examples for bringing services up on Thor, plus troubleshooting tips for latency spikes.
Testing:
- Validate instructions by running through them on a Jetson staging environment where possible or via emulation; capture gaps as TODOs.

title: Add integration tests for STT module
description:
The STT module (stt/ directory, 333 lines) handles speech-to-text but has limited integration test coverage.

Key components:
- speech_to_text.py: STT WebSocket client (228 lines)
- dummy_speech_to_text.py: Mock implementation for testing

Testing needed:
- STT WebSocket connection lifecycle
- Audio streaming to STT service
- Transcription result handling
- Error recovery and reconnection
- Integration with audio buffer

Create or extend tests/test_stt_integration.py with comprehensive scenarios.

title: Build OpenAI Realtime conformance harness
description:
Scope:
- Build a Python harness (e.g., `tests/realtime_harness/runner.py`) that launches a headless FastAPI+uvicorn instance, replays canonical OpenAI trace fixtures (audio bursts, text-only, tool call sequences, multimodal inputs) over the `/v1/realtime` websocket, and asserts byte-level protocol compliance (event order, payload schemas, ack timing).
- Provide CLI entrypoints + docs for running the harness locally.
- Store sample trace fixtures under `tests/realtime_harness/fixtures/` with README.
Testing:
- Ensure harness itself has unit tests for trace parsing, timing assertions, and fixture validation.
- Verify harness can run in CI within reasonable time (<5 min) and emits structured reports.

title: Add module docstrings to files missing them
description:
~36% of Python files are missing module-level docstrings. These provide important context for developers.

Files needing module docstrings:
- unmute/audio_input_override.py
- unmute/tts/voice_cloning.py
- unmute/tts/voice_donation.py
- unmute/tts/copy_approved_voice_donations.py
- unmute/llm/chatbot.py
- unmute/llm/quiz_show_questions.py
- unmute/loadtest/*.py (4 files)
- Most scripts in unmute/scripts/

Target: Add descriptive module docstrings explaining purpose, usage, and key concepts.

title: Design per-session audio buffer manager
description:
Scope:
- Introduce a per-session audio buffer manager (e.g., `unmute/audio/realtime_buffer.py`) that stores `input_audio_buffer.append` frames with timestamps, sequence counters, codec metadata, and handles Opus→PCM decode with overflow protection.
- Integrate the manager into `main_websocket.receive_loop` and `UnmuteHandler.receive`, exposing APIs for append, commit/flush, rewind, and STT streaming.
- Track latency metadata (arrival→STT flush) for emission via `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.*` events.
- Provide hooks for anonymized recording without storing raw audio.
Testing:
- Unit tests for buffer ordering, sequence validation, codec guardrails, and commit/reset semantics.
- Integration tests simulating append/flush event flows to confirm STT invocation timing and emitted transcription events with expected metadata.

title: Add unit tests for cache.py
description:
cache.py (111 lines) implements a generic cache with Redis and in-memory backends.

The module provides:
- CacheInterface abstract base class
- RedisCache implementation
- InMemoryCache implementation
- Error handling (CacheError)

Testing needed:
- Cache get/set/delete operations
- TTL expiration behavior
- Error handling when Redis unavailable
- In-memory fallback behavior

Create tests/test_cache.py with coverage for both backends.

title: Add unit tests for recorder.py
description:
recorder.py (117 lines) handles recording infrastructure for debugging but has no dedicated tests.

The module provides:
- Event recording with timestamps
- Recording file management
- Anonymized audio event handling

Testing needed:
- Event recording and retrieval
- File I/O handling
- Anonymization of audio data
- Recording lifecycle (start, stop, save)

Create tests/test_recorder.py with basic coverage.

title: Add harness fuzzing & latency benchmarks
description:
Scope:
- Extend the conformance harness with fuzz generators producing duplicate IDs, out-of-order frames, invalid tool outputs, and malformed payloads to ensure the server emits precise `error` events and recovers state.
- Add latency benchmarking modules measuring TTFT, STT flush latency, tool-call RTT, and actuator RTT; enforce configurable thresholds and report regressions.
- Emit machine-readable reports (JSON) consumable by CI dashboards.
Testing:
- Unit tests for fuzz generators and latency calculators.
- Integration tests running fuzz suites against a mocked server to confirm expected error handling.
- Validate harness CLI supports selecting fuzz/latency modes.

title: Remove dead code in session_state.py (unused image/metadata buffer methods)
description:
After removing InputImageBuffer and InputMetadata events, the following methods in session_state.py are now unused:

- append_image_buffer()
- commit_image_buffer()
- clear_image_buffer()
- append_metadata()

These methods and any related state (image buffer, metadata storage) should be removed to reduce code complexity and maintenance burden.

Note: Verify no other code paths use these methods before removal.

title: Reduce complexity in loadtest_client.py
description:
loadtest_client.py has moderate complexity issues:
- 485 lines with 62 branches
- 49 deeply nested lines
- 3 functions with >5 parameters
- 6 untyped functions

Recommended improvements:
1. Extract client coordination logic into separate strategy classes
2. Use dataclasses or TypedDict for function parameters
3. Add type hints to remaining untyped functions
4. Reduce nesting with early returns and guard clauses

This is lower priority as it's test infrastructure, not production code.

title: Add docstrings to TTS module files
description:
Several TTS module files lack documentation:

- voice_donation.py: 139 lines, 0 docstrings
- voice_cloning.py: 97 lines, 0 docstrings  
- copy_approved_voice_donations.py: 95 lines, 0 docstrings
- text_to_speech.py: 355 lines, only 4 docstrings

These files handle voice management, cloning, and TTS streaming which are important for understanding the audio pipeline.

Target: Add module docstrings and function/class docstrings to all TTS files.

title: Profile and optimize hot paths in audio processing
description:
The audio processing pipeline (realtime_buffer.py, unmute_handler.py) handles real-time audio and should be profiled for performance.

Areas to investigate:
- Opus decoding latency in realtime_buffer.py
- Audio buffer management overhead
- PCM sample accumulation
- Latency tracking overhead

Optimization opportunities:
- Reduce allocations in hot paths
- Consider numpy optimizations
- Profile async overhead
- Review buffer copy operations

Use pyinstrument (already in dev dependencies) to profile during load testing.

title: Refactor unmute_handler.py into smaller handler classes
description:
unmute_handler.py is the largest file (1,062 lines) with critical complexity issues:
- 147 conditional branches
- 174 lines with extreme nesting (>20 spaces indentation)
- 19 untyped functions
- Handles too many concerns: response routing, VAD events, STT/TTS lifecycle, audio buffer management, metrics, debugging

Recommended refactoring:
1. Extract VADHandler class for voice activity detection logic
2. Extract AudioHandler class for audio buffer management
3. Extract EventRouter class for event dispatch logic
4. Keep UnmuteHandler as a facade coordinating these handlers

This will improve testability, reduce cognitive load, and enable parallel development.

title: Add 'type' field to Session model for OpenAI SDK compatibility
description:
OpenAI's RealtimeSessionCreateRequest requires a 'type' field with value 'session' or 'transcription_session'. Our Session model doesn't include this field.

Failing tests:
- test_validate_session_update_against_openai
- test_validate_session_created_against_openai

Fix: Add type: Literal['session', 'transcription_session'] | None = None to Session model in openai_realtime_api_events.py

title: Standardize image_url format to string for OpenAI compatibility
description:
OpenAI expects image_url as a string (data URI or URL), but our InputImageContentPart uses a dict format.

Current implementation:
  image_url: dict[str, str] | None  # {"url": "data:image/..."}

OpenAI standard:
  image_url: str | None  # "data:image/png;base64,..."

Files to update:
- unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.py: InputImageContentPart, ImageContentPart

This change aligns with the official OpenAI Python client types and enables direct compatibility with OpenAI's Realtime API.

title: Define actuator tool schemas
description:
Scope:
- Create a shared actuator tool schema module (e.g., `unmute/tooling/tool_schemas.py`) defining JSON-schema-like specs for `move_arm`, `rotate_base`, `set_gaze`, `play_sound`, `capture_frame`, etc., including argument validation, units, and timeout budgets.
- Provide helper functions to register schemas with the LLM prompt/system instructions and to serialize tool call deltas into validated dataclasses.
- Update the LLM prompt builder and `UnmuteHandler` tool-call plumbing to rely on these schemas instead of ad-hoc dicts.
Testing:
- Unit tests verifying schema validation for each tool, including invalid inputs and timeout defaults.
- Snapshot tests ensuring generated tool descriptors match what the LLM expects.

title: Implement realtime health probes
description:
Scope:
- Implement readiness/liveness probes exposing realtime capacity: STT backlog, LLM queue depth, actuator availability, audio buffer health.
- Extend `get_health` or add new endpoints returning granular metrics consumed by Kubernetes/Jetson supervisors, and gate session admission based on probe data.
- Ensure probes integrate with Prometheus metrics and emit alerts when thresholds exceeded.
Testing:
- Unit tests for probe computation logic and gating decisions.
- Integration tests simulating degraded STT/LLM/actuator services to confirm probes transition to unhealthy and session onboarding is blocked.

title: Track milestone validation & reporting
description:
Scope:
- Define acceptance criteria/checklists for each milestone (Protocol MVP, Audio+Tool Integration, Multimodal Ready, Harness Green, Jetson Validation) reflecting exit criteria in `Step_1_realtime.md`.
- Establish reporting cadence (weekly summaries) capturing status of upstream tasks, blockers, and metrics; store in shared doc or beads notes.
- Ensure dependencies across teams (actuator, sensors, Jetson ops) are documented with owners and due dates.
Testing:
- Review checklists with stakeholders; ensure they reference concrete tests/artifacts (harness runs, latency reports) and can be validated automatically where possible.
- Validate first reporting cycle using current task statuses.

title: Add docstrings to process_recording.py
description:
process_recording.py has very poor documentation coverage:
- 449 lines of code
- Only 5 docstrings (1.1% coverage)
- 7 functions with 62 branches

This file handles recording playback and audio visualization logic which is complex and needs documentation for:
- Function purposes and parameters
- Audio processing algorithms
- Visualization data structures

Target: Add docstrings to all public functions and classes.

title: Simplify validation logic in tool_schemas.py
description:
tool_schemas.py has extreme complexity in validation logic:
- 448 lines with 100 lines having deep nesting (>20 spaces)
- 59 branches across validation functions
- Robot actuator schema validation creates deeply nested structures

Recommended improvements:
1. Extract validator classes for each actuator type
2. Use Pydantic validators instead of manual validation where possible
3. Flatten nested conditional logic using early returns
4. Consider using a validation library or pattern (e.g., cerberus, schema)

This will make the tool schemas more maintainable and testable.

title: Add unit tests for service_discovery.py
description:
service_discovery.py (147 lines) handles service instance discovery and health checks but has limited test coverage.

The module provides:
- Service endpoint discovery
- Health check coordination
- TTL-cached lookups
- Failover logic

Testing needed:
- Service discovery success/failure paths
- Health check timeout handling
- Cache expiration behavior
- Multiple instance discovery

Create or extend tests to cover service discovery scenarios.

title: Implement realtime multimodal state persistence
description:
Scope:
- Enhance recorder/state serialization to capture audio/image/metadata/tool outputs and conversation items so sessions can resume after reconnect.
- Provide APIs to snapshot handler state (buffers, quests, tool calls) and replay them deterministically when a client reconnects with prior conversation IDs.
- Persist references to uploaded assets in a durable store (filesystem or DB) and cleanly GC them.
Testing:
- Add simulated reconnect tests: run session, disconnect, reconnect with prior state, ensure conversation continues with identical context.
- Unit tests for snapshot/restore helpers verifying deterministic ordering and data retention policies.

title: Expand OpenAI Realtime event models
description:
Scope:
- Audit OpenAI docs and diff against `unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.py`/`unmute/openai_realtime_api_events.pyi` to add all missing client/server event models (conversation items, response state transitions, tool call payloads, image buffers, metadata modalities, errors, ack events).
- Update the discriminated-union TypeAdapters in `unmute/main_websocket.py`, `unmute/scripts/example_websocket_client.py`, and recorder utilities so new models validate and serialize consistently.
- Ensure recorder replay + tests can round-trip newly added enums/fields; extend fixtures for anonymized audio events.
Testing:
- Add `tests/test_openai_realtime_events.py` with sample payload JSON fixtures covering every new event class and verifying `.model_validate_json()`/`.model_dump()` parity.
- Run targeted FastAPI websocket tests to confirm receive/emit code paths accept the expanded unions.
